story: Stage 5 of Paris–Nice began at a very fast pace before a breakaway of five riders formed after 70 km, later joined by three others. After the last escapee was caught on the Côte de Saint-Jean-de-Muzols, Jonas Vingegaard attacked and rode solo for 20 km to win. Valentin Paret-Peintre finished second after riding awying from the group of favourites. Harold Tejada sprinted to third.
